messages.subject: Standard Error or Standard Deviation
parts:
Hi,
Not too sure whether I am thinking in the correct lines, wished to have some assistance regarding this issue. We intend to compare two density estimates obtained with the help of this software. For the same, we are computing one factor ANOVA manually.

In distance software, we get the value of SE (Standard Error).
Now for doing ANOVA manually, s2 (s square) is required. Is the standard error itself the s or do we have to use the following relationship:
s2 = n.(SE)2 ...(1)

If this is true, I have a little problem in case of calculation of CV, which is
CV = s / Mean ...(2)

When we use the above relationship and divide Standard Error by Mean obtained in distance output, we get precisely the CV that is mentioned in the next column of the same output. Now the above two are contradicting and affect results of ANOVA test heavily. The question I have is whether we shall consider SE as s for the manual calculation of ANOVA or calculate its value first by using equation (1)?



Koustubh
